standard: Historical single-curator source decisions retained as proposals. Only agreement between two distinct recorded source reviewers enters benchmark totals. Missing, unresolved or conflicting reviews are quarantined; no model-score or majority resolution. Previously exposed development examples; no claim of blinded multi-human adjudication, current ownership, threshold calibration or population accuracy.

reviewPolicy.revisions: Append to the same reviewer's history with supersedes naming the immediately preceding review ID. Compare only active decisions; preserve all earlier decisions and disagreements.
reviewPolicy.timestamps: observedAt records the review's source observation time, not review or preparation time; null means unknown. Evidence records retain each original source observation time. reviewedAt is separately recorded and remains null for legacy reviews whose review time was not retained.
reviewPolicy.disagreements: The separate disagreements ledger may record caseId, primaryReviewId, secondReviewId, rationale and recordedAt for a disputed pair. Preparation also detects unrecorded conflicts and explicitly reports each differing primary/second pair, retaining both decisions. Only a disagreement between active decisions quarantines a fully reviewed case; deleting a ledger entry cannot resolve conflict.
reviewPolicy.legacy: legacy-source-curator identifies the original single-curator provenance, not a newly performed review. Empty second histories honestly record that no second review has been performed.
